thread:
sara_cs: Heads up — Vellum Analytics requested help scoping a domain-adapted 70B summarizer for clinical notes. They require PHI isolation + customer HSM/KMS, timeline ~6 weeks. Renewal is in 8 weeks; CS flagged as at-risk if we don't show progress. Kicking off here.

jason_se: Thanks. Can you paste their core SLAs and expected traffic? dedicated/private? any throughput estimates?

sara_cs: Private (VPC) deployment, they want Redwood-hosted private control plane. QPS: 1-2 steady, bursts to ~10. Latency SLO ~600ms p95. They want strict PHI redaction, hallucination monitoring, and an eval dataset (~200k de-identified notes) to validate.

rui_ml: From ML side: they asked for 70B for accuracy, but we should validate if a quantized 13B can meet thresholds first to save cost. Proposed evals: summarization ROUGE/chrF, entity-preservation for PHI, and explicit PHI leakage tests. Need their golden references and prompt templates.

anya_sre: Infra note: private + HSM support is fine but requires security sign-off and VPC peering. We'll need architecture diagram, certificate chain, and an HSM provisioning window — estimate ~2 weeks lead after approvals. Also callout: private control plane means extra audit log retention config.

sara_cs: Sales/Renewal note: renewal ops flagged this as a top priority. If we can deliver a working canary within 6 weeks they'll consider extending/expanding. @jason_se can you own SLA commitments and the enablement artifacts?

jason_se: I can. One question: will the model be customer-supplied artifact or do they expect Redwood to host a vetted third-party model image? If they're supplying artifacts we need a different onboarding flow (model verification + signed manifest).

sara_cs: They plan to supply the VellumFine-70B artifacts in S3 and want Redwood to host within their Private tenancy. They'll also share the eval dataset after the NDA is in place.

rui_ml: OK. I'll draft an eval playbook. Rough draft config below — will iterate with the team:

```yaml
eval_suite:
  name: vellum-70b-clinical
  datasets: [gold_notes_1k, gold_notes_10k]
  metrics: [rouge-L, chrF, entity_F1, phi_leak_rate]
  safety_checks:
    - phi_extraction: threshold 0.01
    - hallucination_detection: classifier_v3
  rollout_plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with automatic rollback if phi_leak_rate > 0.02
```

rui_ml: I'll also include an entity-level F1 for protected classes and a manual spot-check workflow for ambiguous cases.

anya_sre: Add an immediate rollback + paging trigger to SRE if phi_leak_rate > 0.02 during canary. Also note private onboarding needs the private control plane checklist completed before any canary.

sara_cs: Next steps: rui to own eval cert + timeline, anya to own infra checklist & security sign-off, jason to own commercial/SLA docs. I'm scheduling a 30m kickoff with Vellum for tomorrow 2pm PT. :spiral_calendar:

jason_se: :thumbsup: I'll prepare a short demo runbook and an enablement checklist for their engineering team.

rui_ml: I'll stand up an eval harness tomorrow — will need 5x A100-equivalent GPUs to run the 10k eval within 24h. Flagging resource request.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket CS-9241 (private-onboard-vellum) and infra request INF-5789 (hsm-provisioning).

sara_cs: Adding renewal note to account record: probability of churn high unless we deliver a validated canary in 6 weeks. Tagging accountops for visibility and follow-up.

(ending)
